Good, then we do it with a plan instead of just adding weight. Pushing harder works best through one lever at a time: add a rep or a small bit of load on your main lifts, or finish sets closer to failure, with 1 to 2 reps in the tank rather than grinding to a miss. Sleep and eating enough matter more than most people think when you raise the intensity.

If you want, I can look at your recent lifts and tell you where there's room to push, or build a harder session for today. Which do you want?
